REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - JUNE 5, 2024 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Community Development Department counter, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development counter during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

  Regular Planning Commission Meeting
  June 5, 2024
  City Council Chambers
  18125 Bloomfield Ave, Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Gene Burd
  Commissioner Deepak “DJ” Jhaveri
  Commissioner Gloria Perlas Pulido
  Chair Carla Gilhuys

PRESENT:  City Attorney Bill Irhke
  Assistant City Manager Kathleen Matsumoto
  Community Development Director Kristin Aguila
  Acting Director of Public Works/City Engineer Dario Simoes
  Current Planning Manager Sandy Cisneros
  Advanced Planning Manager Sabrina Chan
  Senior Planner Jeremy Loh
  Associate Planner Michael Fialho
  Associate Planner Wyman Wong
  Associate Civil Engineer Amandeep Mann

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  Commissioner Burd led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present, except Commissioner
  Gandhi, who was noted absent.

4.  Annual Reorganization of the Planning Commission

  Community Development Director Kristin Aguila declared the position of Chair of
  the Planning Commission vacant and called for nominations.

  Vice Chair Jhaveri nominated Commissioner Gilhuys for Chair. Commissioner Burd
  seconded the nomination.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were closed.

  Commissioner Gilhuys was declared Chair unanimously, and took her place on the
  dais.

  Community Development Director Kristin Aguila declared the position of Vice Chair
  of the Planning Commission vacant and called for nominations.
   Chair Gilhuys nominated Commissioner Gandhi for Vice Chair. Commissioner Burd
  seconded the nomination.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were closed.

  Commissioner Gandhi was declared Vice Chair.

5.  Presentation of Plaques

  On behalf of the Planning Commission, Community Development Director Kristin
  Aguila presented a plaque to outgoing Chair Deepak “DJ” Jhaveri in appreciation of
  his service as Chair of the Commission.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  There were no public comments or written correspondence received and Chair Gilhuys
  declared the Public Comments and Suggestions portion of the meeting closed.

7.  Approval of the Wednesday, May 1, 2024, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission
  Regular Meeting Minutes

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Pulido, and seconded by
  Commissioner Burd to approve the Planning Commission regular meeting
  minutes of May 1, 2024, as presented.

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Burd, Jhaveri, Pulido, Gilhuys
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Gandhi
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Commissioners discussed development project valuation, criteria and

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Jhaveri, and seconded by

9.  New and Old Business

  9A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION FINDING THE PROPOSED CITY
  OF CERRITOS CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-
  2025 IN CONFORMITY WITH THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN

City of Cerritos  June 5, 2024
Planning Commission Minutes  Page 5
   Acting Director of Public Works/City Engineer Dario Simoes presented details
  about the proposed Fiscal Year 2024-2024 City of Cerritos Capital
  Improvement Program (CIP). Commissioners discussed the following topics:
  the Cerritos Sculpture Garden, fiber optic network improvements, park
  renovations, the Del Amo Boulevard Bridge replacement project, Measure M,
  arterial landscaping, residential parkway trees, and any changes that may
  have occurred between the CIP presentation in 2023 and the CIP
  presentation in 2024.

  Chair Gilhuys opened public comments. Seeing none, Chair Gilhuys closed
  public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Jhaveri, and seconded by
  Commissioner Pulido to waive full reading of and adopt a resolution
  captioned as follows, recommending City Council approval:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION FINDING THE
  PROPOSED CITY OF CERRITOS CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM FOR
  FISCAL YEAR 2024-2025 IN CONFORMITY WITH THE CERRITOS GENERAL
  PLAN.

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Burd, Jhaveri, Pulido, Gilhuys
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Gandhi
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Communications

  10A.  Reports from the Department of Community Development

  Director of Community Development Kristin Aguila stated that the next
  Planning Commision meeting is scheduled for July 3, 2024, and deferred to
  City Attorney Bill Ihrke for comments related to the excusal of Vice Chair
  Gandhi, after which the Commission took action accordingly.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chair Gilhuys, and seconded by Commissioner
  Jhaveri to excuse the absence of Commissioner Bavin Gandhi.

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Burd, Jhaveri, Pulido, Gilhuys
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Gandhi
  ABSTAIN:  None

  10B.  Reports from Cerritos Planning Commissioners

  Commissioners thanked Commissioner Jhaveri for serving as Chair, and
  congratulated Chair Gilhuys and Vice Chair Gandhi on their new roles.
